text:
If you’ve got outdoor plans, today is the day to use them, with sunshine, a high right around 78, and a light south wind. The air is cool this morning, but it’ll turn comfortably warm by afternoon. On the lake, south winds run 10 to 15 knots with waves around 1 to 2 feet, and the water is a refreshing 72. Tonight stays partly cloudy, with a low near 60, while the wind picks up to 15 to 20 knots before easing.

Sunday is the less certain call. Expect a partly sunny start, then showers or a thunderstorm become possible after roughly 2, with a 50 percent chance overall and a high near 78. The forecast models disagree on how wet it gets, so I’d bet on scattered afternoon showers rather than a washout, but carry the rain jacket. Enjoy the lake today, and aim to finish longer outings before Sunday afternoon’s weather moves in.

Tonight will be a bit chilly with lows in the 40s to near 50 degrees. A few of the colder valleys will dip into the upper 30s. Patchy fog is possible early Saturday morning, otherwise it will be sunny and beautiful with highs in the 70s. Sunday looks iffy, as computer models disagree with how wet it’s going to be.
